svg.title: Read the matrix, name the pair
svg.desc: The real ten by ten confusion matrix for the plain CNN on 540 held-out digits, rows being what the digit really was and columns what the model said, with 529 counts on the green diagonal and eleven red counts off it, including a 3 in row 8 column 1 and a 1 in row 1 column 8. Underneath are six empty dashed boxes to fill in: the diagonal total, the off-diagonal total, whether they make 540, the biggest off-diagonal cell with its row and column, its mirror cell, and the confusion pair. The answers are 529, 11, yes because 529 plus 11 is 540, row 8 column 1 holding 3, row 1 column 8 holding 1, and the pair 1 and 8.
svg.text: Read the matrix, name the pair
